content:
The **Blue Ridge Office** is an unmarked location at Big Bend Tunnel West in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia.

The Blue Ridge Office is a two-story building constructed out of wood at the Blue Ridge Caravan Company's outpost at Big Bend Tunnel. It was added in the *Steel Reign* update.

On the first floor, to the left is Herschel Klein's bar, while on the right is a pool table, a jukebox playing unique music, as well a Ham Radio and television. Heading up the stairs, there is a small kitchen area with a Cooking Station, a fridge and several shelves for storage. During Out of the Blue, Aries will be on guard here, though he will return to his normal place at Big Bend Tunnel East after the quest is completed. Joanna Mayfield's office is on this floor; she can be found working on her desk terminal (cannot be interacted with by the player) at all times, beside a Safe.

The Blue Ridge Office appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Steel Reign* update.

Steve Massey stated that the microphone in the Blue Ridge Office is part of a karaoke booth. [Dev 1]
